name: age
text: The start age of a game mode when --age is dark (setup.jsonl line of an age).

name: ages
text: A start age: the number of ages that the players have at the start (0 Dark ... 4 Post-Imperial).

name: bots
text: A game mode that the bots can play.

name: buildings
text: A game mode with a start town: the number of each building of build.jsonl.

name: help
text: The help text of a game mode for --mode.

name: heroes
text: The start heroes of a game mode for each player (not Gaia), of units.jsonl (battle_royale.heroes).

name: infinite
text: A resource level where a cost does not lower the stock.

name: level
text: A game mode with the resource level of this name when --resources is standard.

name: loaded
text: What a game mode does in a loaded game: skip or start.

name: module
text: The module of game/ with setup(g, mode) of a game mode.

name: more
text: The extra start units of a game mode: the number of each unit of train.jsonl.

name: none
text: The resources that a game mode sets to 0 at the start (not with an infinite level).

name: note
text: The source of the values (the AoE2 wiki page) and the issue.

name: random
text: A resource level that is one of these levels, at random.

name: resources
text: A resource level: the start amount of food, wood, gold and stone.

name: ring
text: A ring of walls with a gate around each base: radius, wall and gate.

name: side_buildings
text: The start buildings of each side of a game mode.

name: sides
text: The start resources of each side of a game mode (ally, attacker, defender).

name: sites
text: The start buildings of a game mode of buildings.jsonl that each player gets on a free site of the map.

name: skip
text: The technologies of train.jsonl that a start age does not research.

name: slow
text: The items of a speed setting that keep the AoE2 speed (units.jsonl, buildings.jsonl).

name: start
text: The start resources of a game mode for each resource level of --resources.

name: swap
text: The technologies of train.jsonl that a game mode puts in place of others (old: new).

name: treaty
text: The treaty of a game mode: endless, no player can attack another.

name: turbo
text: A speed setting: the factor of the work, gather, carry and build speed.

name: units
text: A game mode with these start units of units.jsonl (an empty list: no change).

name: villagers
text: The start villagers of a game mode at each resource.

name: wonder_years
text: A game mode with a wonder victory after this number of years (0: at once).
